name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
History/Downloads Sheet Fixed: Eliminated screen-freeze bug where the drawer stayed permanently open; sheet is strictly docked off-screen until opened.
Footer Navigation & Spacing: Navigation bar properly elevated with Android system inset padding; active pills and labels are never truncated or obscured.
Settings & Forms Alignment: Fixed dropdown select rows to prevent awkward multi-line text wrapping; refined cache and cookie action buttons.
Cookie Guide & Modal Scrolling: Centered dialog cards with internal scrolling, preventing step descriptions from overlapping the close button.
Glossy Glass & Aurora Themes: Full restoration of liquid glassmorphism, specular top rims, and cyber aurora glow with zero GPU rectangular clipping.
Quick Share Sheet Overhaul: Complete AMOLED and Glass redesign of the quick-share popup when sharing links from YouTube or Instagram.
